# viettelcloud_volume (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Block Storage volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_volume" "empty" {
  name        = "example-empty-volume"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  size        = 30
  iops        = 1000

  create_from = {
    source_type = "empty"
    volume_type = { name = "Ceph_HDD_1A_10K" }
  }
}

resource "viettelcloud_volume" "image" {
  name = "example-image-volume"
  size = 30

  create_from = {
    source_type = "image"
    image       = { os = "Ubuntu", version = "22.04" }
    volume_type = { name = "Ceph_HDD_1A_10K" }
  }
}

resource "viettelcloud_volume" "custom_image" {
  name = "example-custom-image-volume"
  size = 30

  create_from = {
    source_type  = "custom_image"
    custom_image = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" }
    volume_type  = { name = "Ceph_HDD_1A_10K" }
  }
}

resource "viettelcloud_volume" "snapshot" {
  name = "example-snapshot-volume"

  create_from = {
    source_type = "snapshot"
    snapshot    = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002" }
  }
}

resource "viettelcloud_volume" "backup" {
  name = "example-backup-volume"
  size = 30

  create_from = {
    source_type = "backup"
    backup      = { id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003" }
    volume_type = { name = "Ceph_HDD_1A_10K" }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `create_from` (Attributes) Immutable volume source. Configure only fields used by source_type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from))
- `name` (String) Name of the volume.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional volume description. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it.
- `iops` (Number) Provisioned IOPS. Omitting it preserves the backend value.
- `size` (Number) Volume size in GiB. Required except for snapshot sources; it can only be increased after creation.
- `zone` (Attributes) Zone where the volume is created. Changing it replaces the volume. Removing it keeps the current zone. Do not set it for snapshot sources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zone))

### Read-Only

- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether the volume is bootable.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was created (RFC3339).
- `encrypted` (Boolean) Whether the volume is encrypted.
- `id` (String) Volume ID (UUID).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID) owning the volume.
- `status` (String) Current volume status.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the volume was last updated (RFC3339).
- `volume_type` (String) Effective volume type name.
- `zone_id` (String) Zone ID (UUID) where the volume resides.

<a id="nestedatt--create_from"></a>
### Nested Schema for `create_from`

Required:

- `source_type` (String) Source type: empty, image, custom_image, snapshot, or backup.

Optional:

- `backup` (Attributes) Source backup; valid only for a backup source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from--backup))
- `custom_image` (Attributes) Source custom image; valid only for a custom_image source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from--custom_image))
- `image` (Attributes) Image selector. Supply at least one criterion. Creation requires exactly one image. Changed criteria keep the current image when it still matches. Valid only for image sources. Selecting a different image replaces the volume. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from--image))
- `snapshot` (Attributes) Source snapshot; valid only for a snapshot source. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from--snapshot))
- `volume_type` (Attributes) Volume type selector. Supply at least one criterion. New selections require exactly one enabled, up volume type in the requested zone. Changed criteria keep the current type when it still matches. Required except for snapshot sources. Selecting a different type retypes the volume in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--create_from--volume_type))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a volume by ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_volume.data 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789

# The backend can report several origins for one volume, for example a snapshot
# of a volume that itself came from an image. Refreshing a volume reads state
# rather than configuration, so the intended origin has to arrive with the
# import ID: append the create_from.source_type the volume should be recorded
# with (empty, image, custom_image, snapshot, or backup).
terraform import viettelcloud_volume.data 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789,snapshot
```
